focus: Boston proper (South End / Mass Ave, South Boston, Charlestown, East Boston, Brighton) plus nearby Somerville and Everett
intro: These Boston listings were checked on the operators’ own facility pages on November 26, 2026, and cover ten facilities from Public Storage and CubeSmart: inside the city in the South End and Massachusetts Ave corridor, South Boston, Charlestown, East Boston next to Logan Airport, and Brighton, plus three Public Storage locations just over the line in Somerville and Everett. We copied published access hours and office hours separately, and we only flag climate control, month-to-month leases, and deliveries when the facility’s own page says so (all ten list climate-controlled storage; the four CubeSmart pages say they accept deliveries). None of these facilities publish around-the-clock access hours: most gates open 6:00 AM–10:00 PM, the Charlestown CubeSmart closes at 9:00 PM, and the Southampton St Public Storage and Massachusetts Ave CubeSmart keep shorter daytime windows. Four Public Storage pages show a “24/7 Access Available” badge even though their access tables are 6:00 AM–10:00 PM, so we recorded the tables and noted the badge. This is a starting sample, not a citywide inventory; Extra Space Storage, local independents, Dorchester, Jamaica Plain, and Cambridge are not covered yet. We do not cache live unit prices or vacancy.
